## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits, for example `feat(cli): add oxispec link`
- [ ] Tests cover the new behavior
- [ ] Docs are updated, and `docs/design.md` too if a decision changed
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] Breaking changes are marked with `!` in the title and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` note below
